title: What mythical creature am I? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free mythical creature quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're a dragon, phoenix, unicorn, griffin, mermaid, kitsune, werewolf or pegasus. No sign-up.
lede: Fierce like a dragon, reborn like a phoenix or clever like a nine-tailed fox? Answer 12 questions to find the legendary creature that shares your spirit.
about: Myths from around the world are full of creatures that stand for human traits. The phoenix of Greek and Egyptian legend burns and rises again from its ashes; the dragon is a fearsome hoard-keeper in European tales and a wise bringer of rain in Chinese ones; the kitsune of Japanese folklore is a clever fox spirit that grows more tails as it gains wisdom. This quiz matches you with one of eight famous creatures.

Your result names your creature, says what it shows about you and gives your scores for all eight. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, not a scientific test. If you enjoy it, try the spirit animal and Greek god quizzes on this site.

faq.a: Dragon, phoenix, unicorn, griffin, mermaid, kitsune (the Japanese fox spirit), werewolf and pegasus.

faq.q: Is one creature rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every creature appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.
A fox spirit from Japanese folklore. Kitsune are clever shape-shifters, sometimes tricksters and sometimes loyal guardians, and they grow up to nine tails as they get older and wiser.
No. It's just for fun, and your answers stay in your browser.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.body: You are powerful, proud and fiercely protective. You guard the people and things you treasure, and you have a wise, ancient streak that makes people listen when you speak. In European tales dragons are fearsome; in Chinese ones they're wise bringers of luck. You can be both.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.body: You are bright, resilient and full of life. Setbacks don't end your story; they become the start of a new chapter. Your energy and hope warm the people around you, and you have a gift for helping others heal and start again.

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.body: You are kind, gentle and true to yourself. You have a pure heart and a quiet strength, and you're braver than you look. You're one of a kind, and people feel lucky to know you.

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.body: Part lion, part eagle, you are brave, watchful and loyal. In legend griffins guard treasure, and you guard the people and principles you care about. You keep your word, you see the big picture and you never leave a friend behind.

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.body: You are free-spirited, curious and a little mysterious. You follow your own currents, love adventure and won't be tied down. People are drawn to your charm, but only a few get to know the depths.

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.body: Like the fox spirit of Japanese folklore, you are clever, playful and adaptable. You can talk your way out of almost anything and you grow wiser every year. Mischievous with strangers and loyal to friends, you keep life interesting.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.body: You are loyal, intense and protective of your pack. You seem calm on the surface, but you have a wild, passionate side that comes out when it matters. Your friends know you'll always have their back.

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.body: You are free, inspiring and a dreamer. Like the winged horse of Greek myth, you aim high and lift other people's spirits. Your ideas take people places, and you're happiest when you have room to fly.
